episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.summary: When an aircraft crashes nearby, siblings Liv, Elja and Kiano and the other Origines fall prey to the Crows, who seek a powerful Atlantian artifact.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.summary: Moses, a nomadic scavenger, takes Elja under his wing. Determined to rescue her family from Brahtok, Liv makes an unexpected deal with a Crows warrior.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.summary: To gain Grieta's trust, Liv takes matters into her own hands. Elja turns the Cube on in front of Moses and Amena. Kiano's plot to gain freedom unravels.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.summary: Elja, Moses and Amena enlist Bracker's help to fix the Cube. Liv's plan hits a snag. Lord Varvara asks Kiano about his past.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.summary: Elja tries to convince Bracker to give back the Cube. Liv faces a dilemma amid a plot within the Crimson command. Lord Varvara grants Kiano his wish.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.summary: Kiano faces a shocking rival at his Boj. General Cameron's bid for peace with the Crows takes a tragic turn. The Cube leads Elja and Moses to a portal.
